Review is bound to the three exact refreshed hashes. Later evidence revisions require a new comparison; canonical integration and final scientific approval are outside this bounded review.
transferable_lessons: Reproduce the actual donor selector; source stage weighting changes who contributes and how much.
Distinguish a historical family bridge for one genus from the full modern family boundary.
Check native average-or-maximum size rules and species accounts before treating provider size bins as observations.
A nested taxon cannot receive a broader ecological-size set than its coarse reporting category without an explicit reporting restriction or disclosed approximation.
Genuine source zeros remain candidates; author-assumed catches are usable approved proxies but must remain visibly assumed.
Assess membership and allocation separately and preserve the weakest required confidence.
